column1: # Disjoint fields in the single uint64 carrier on entity and physicality.
# Flag banks store one true/false bit per slot (bit = offset + slot), OR-combinable
# and GIN-indexed via laplace_mask_ops. Enum banks store slot+1 (zero means absent).
# Slot identities are compositions of the key text in slots/LIST.tsv.
# The Unicode property cache is separate and retains its 256-bit UCD records.
